description: LFM2-MoE prefill-path depthwise causal conv1d (kernel_size=3, no activation). Input is unpadded; the entry point left-pads by K-1 internally.
name: lfm2_moe_causal_conv1d_prefill
reference:
# Source: https://github.com/huggingface/transformers/blob/main/src/transformers/models/lfm2_moe/modeling_lfm2_moe.py (Lfm2MoeShortConv, causal_conv1d_fn path)
import torch
import torch.nn.functional as F

def run(x, weight):
    B, D, L = x.shape
    K = weight.shape[1]
    xp = F.pad(x, (K - 1, 0))
    w = weight.view(D, 1, K)
    return F.conv1d(xp, w, groups=D)
